report.summary: 4 reviewed findings: 2 confirmed, 1 narrowed, 1 needs-evidence. Ordered items address critical egress misaccounting, high-risk default containment, medium spectral caller audit, and medium decoy-first false positive.
risks: OllamaProvider.caps may set local=True, causing budget to miss egress costs for warm_model HTTP requests.
GateResult.containment default None would weaken audit trail if any construction path omits it.
Callers of spectral_evidence may misinterpret missing keys as 'not measured' vs 'not in graph'.
check_anchoring returns 'anchored_on_decoy' without verifying correct answer, causing false positives.
todos: Audit OllamaProvider.caps for local flag and budget egress charging logic.
Find GateResult definition and check containment default and all instantiation sites.
Audit all callers of spectral_evidence for missing key handling.
Inspect check_anchoring in canary.py for correct answer check before decoy verdict.

items.title: Fix budget egress tracking for OllamaProvider.warm_model
items.why_now: Critical: if OllamaProvider.caps sets local=True, budget system ignores egress costs for warm_model HTTP requests, causing silent cost undercount.

steps.do: Check OllamaProvider.caps for local flag in daedalus/providers/ollama.py
Check budget egress charging logic in daedalus/council/session.py for dynamic host inspection
If local=True and no dynamic check, modify caps to set local=False or add dynamic egress detection
steps.verified_by: Run relevant budget tests (e.g., test_budget.py) and confirm egress tracked

items.assumption: OllamaProvider.caps exists and contains a local field; budget system is in session.py

items.title: Verify and fix GateResult.containment default to prevent incomplete audit records
items.why_now: High: if containment defaults to None, any construction path omitting it weakens audit trail for gate results.

steps.do: Find GateResult class definition in daedalus/spine/attempt.py and check containment field default
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'class GateResult' daedalus/spine/attempt.py; grep -A 10 'class GateResult' daedalus/spine/attempt.py

steps.do: Audit all instantiation sites of GateResult for containment argument
If default is None, change to a sentinel or require explicit value; add test for completeness
